question: In a certain code language, 'GLARE' is written as '201526922', 'DUST' is written as '23687'. How will ‘HYPER’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Opposite letter's position value is written against each letter according the English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• GLARE is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02d13fbeda3625386596498bdb9fa815913a972b77cb30d6326a7bfa95cb3508.png] ​

 
• DUST is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78a767b17502a116ee36ec5328ca118e06b0da2e3d390ed52107a737042801f0.png] ​

Similarly,

 
• HYPER is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/132a55c33cabe3f5f44ccf8e56c3cfeaec7939967e9a69ba21652207c7ca3f8c.png] ​

Hence, **"****19211229"** is the correct answer.

73:T
